data.name: Help
data.value: Game Garage RAM conformance sweep Usage: StabilityTest.exe [/Passes N] [/ReserveGB N|N%] [/Threads N|N%] [/Seed N] Defaults: 10 update passes plus final readback; reserve 1 GiB; use 50% of logical processors. The initial available-memory allocation is tested without growing it during the run. A reserve check before each pass stops the scan as Inconclusive if memory availability has fallen too far. Ctrl+C cancels. /Background is deferred. Exit codes: 0 Passed, 1 Issues, 2 Error, 3 Cancelled, 4 Inconclusive.
